description: This file defines the Theme class within the Opencart Catalog Controller Event namespace. It contains an index method that retrieves theme information and updates the theme code if a theme override is found.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Handles theme override logic in event-driven manner within the Opencart catalog

methods.name: index
methods.description: Retrieves theme information based on route and current configuration, updating the theme code if a theme override exists.
